name: Ajax Skiras
source:
The son of Telamon—a teacher and the village leader—Ajax is a child prodigy. From a very young age, he has won numerous competitions, a fact that has stirred jealousy among the villagers. He constantly strives for self-improvement and has dedicated his life to his training.

Ajax holds a fatalistic view of the world around him, believing it impossible to alter the rules imposed by the gods. In his eyes, it is easier to resign oneself to one’s lot than to seek a way to change things. He prefers to focus on the present moment and accept his destiny as an instrument of the divinities.
